title: Zines

description.main: A selection of Ari Marcopoulos's zines gathered in one volume from 2015 onward, with an interview by Hamza Walker and an essay by Maggie Nelson.
description.extended:
Zines collects a selection of Ari Marcopoulos's zines in one volume, many of them never released before.

The book starts in 2015 and runs chronologically by year, showing the zines as printed objects and setting single images at full scale between them. It includes the PDF zines Marcopoulos made on screen during the pandemic. An interview with Hamza Walker and an essay by Maggie Nelson place the zines within his daily practice of photographing his life, his family, his neighborhood and the cultural circles around him. Aperture published the 336-page softcover in 2023.

The zines are often self-published or made with independent publishers such as ROMA, Dashwood Books and PPP Editions, and the publisher describes them as working like a sketchbook, a diary and an installation space. The library also holds Marcopoulos's Wonder, one of the Dashwood zines.
